crossing_rule_text: Resolution = 1 / the spatial frequency at which the FRC (5-sample moving average) falls below 1/7 and stays below it (for at least 0.01 nm⁻¹; sustained crossing): the labels sit on a shell about 25-30 nm from the microtubule axis, so the ground-truth spectrum has a null near 1/(60-65 nm) where every curve dips and recovers; that dip is not taken as the resolution.
